newsitem.title: MEXICO: ICA says leads hydro plant auction bids.
newsitem.headline: ICA says leads hydro plant auction bids.

text.p: Mexican construction firm Empresas ICA heads an auction to build a hydro-electric generating plant in Colombia, a company executive said on Thursday.
"We're in the lead, three percent below the next best offer...We're very confident we'll be awarded the contract," said an ICA executive, who wished to remain anonymous.
The contract for civil engineering work at Caruachi is worth approximately $316 million, he said.
Expectations are for the results to be announced "within two months," he said.
ICA is bidding in partnership with Spanish company Dragados y Construcciones and there was the possibility of an additional Colombian partner at a later stage, he added.
